channel.title: Charter Ed Digest
channel.description: News, trends, and practical guidance for charter school leaders and families

item.title: Are Online Charter School Teachers State-Licensed?
item.description: Not all online charter schools require state-licensed teachers. Here's what parents need to know—and what questions to ask before enrolling.

item.title: Why Charter Schools Are Leading the AI Learning Revolution
item.description: Charter schools are adopting AI-powered personalized learning faster than traditional districts. Here's what the trend means for families and school leaders in 2025.

item.title: Why Tracking Attendance Isn't Enough to Fix It
item.description: Nearly 1 in 4 students is still chronically absent. Here's what the latest data says—and what charter schools can actually do about it.

item.title: The Facilities Funding Gap Hurting Charter Schools
item.description: Charter schools lose thousands per pupil to a facilities funding gap. Here's what the data shows and what states—and advocates—are doing to fix it.

item.title: Growth vs. Proficiency: What School Data Really Tells You
item.description: Most parents read test scores wrong. Here's what student growth percentile actually means—and why it's the smarter metric for choosing a K-8 school.

item.title: What Should a Charter School Graduate Look Like?
item.description: Over 20 states now define a "Portrait of a Graduate." Here's why charter high schools are leading this movement—and how families can evaluate any school's vision.

item.title: Chronic Absenteeism: What Charter Schools Do Differently
item.description: Chronic absenteeism still tops 22% nationwide. Here's what charter schools are doing differently—and what every school leader needs to know.

item.title: Mental Health & School Choice: What Charter Schools Offer
item.description: The K-12 mental health crisis is straining traditional schools. Here's how charter and virtual schools offer flexible, structural relief for struggling students.

item.title: Dual Enrollment Gap: Why Charter Schools Are Missing Out
item.description: Charter schools offer dual enrollment at nearly half the rate of traditional high schools. Here's what the research shows—and how to close the gap for your students.

item.title: When Character Education Raises Test Scores Too
item.description: New research shows charter schools that embed leadership and character development school-wide—not as add-ons—see measurable gains in academics, behavior, and family trust.

item.title: School Rankings Decoded: A Charter Family's Guide
item.description: US News, Newsweek, Washington Post Challenge Index — each measures something different. Here's how charter families can use rankings wisely to find the right fit.

item.title: Charter Schools and the Student Mental Health Crisis
item.description: Federal mental health grants are gone. Here's how charter schools' built-in structure—small classes, flexibility, real relationships—gives students a mental health edge.

item.title: How Charter Schools Build a Real College-Going Culture
item.description: What creates record scholarship totals and Ivy acceptances at charter schools? The specific K-12 practices behind the numbers — and what families should ask.

item.title: How to Evaluate a Charter School Before You Enroll
item.description: Before you enroll, know what to look for. A practical guide to vetting charter school quality through accreditation, academics, and the right questions.

item.title: The Charter School Funding Gap: What It Costs Kids
item.description: Charter schools receive thousands less per student than district schools. Here's what the gap costs, what 2025 state wins mean, and what families should ask.

item.title: Dual Enrollment in High School: Charter Schools' Edge
item.description: 55 new dual enrollment laws passed in 2025. Here's why charter schools — especially flex and independent-study models — are uniquely positioned to lead.

item.title: Microschools vs. Charter Schools: What Families Must Know
item.description: Microschools are booming, but they're not all equal. Compare them to charter schools on cost, accountability, and academic outcomes before you choose.

item.title: High-Dosage Tutoring: Charter Schools' Edge in Recovery
item.description: Students are still half a grade level behind pre-pandemic. Here's how high-dosage tutoring works—and why charter schools are best positioned to scale it.

item.title: Win the Teacher Talent War: Charter School Strategies for 2025
item.description: Charter schools face a real teacher shortage in 2025. Here's how mission-driven culture, smart recruiting, and retention strategies give charters a winning edge.

item.title: Why Culturally Responsive Schools Get Better Results
item.description: Research shows culturally responsive curriculum and community-rooted school leadership drive measurable gains in student engagement, attendance, and achievement. Here's the evidence.
